subject: PrivDeploy entitlements & evidence routing — order form redlines
messages:
From: Annika Sorensen <annika.sorensen@starlite-health.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <procurement@starlite-health.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PrivDeploy redlines and evidence ask

Aisha —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the draft MSA + Order Form with our internal controls team and have a few redlines and an evidence request we need to get resolved before legal can sign. High level items:

- License boundary: we need clearer language that runtime access is limited to operator support activities and does not expand license grants for derivative use.
- Operator custody: we cannot accept long-term offsite key escrow without additional safeguards; propose either ephemeral operator keys with attestations or an on-site witness.
- Audit window: our auditors require a 30-day transactional snapshot retention and a 3-business-day window for forensic access (with notice), but we may accept a shorter live-access window if a cryptographic proof-of-creation is provided.
- Evidence delivery: we'd like a staged manifest (checksums + signed attestations) rather than simple file dumps.

I've attached Starlite_Initial_Redline_v1.pdf with inline comments. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred approach for operator key custody and whether you can provide HSM attestation artifacts?

Proposed timeline: legal needs final redline resolved within 10 business days to keep our procurement schedule.

Thanks —
Annika
Annika Sorensen | General Counsel | Starlite Health
Attachments: Starlite_Initial_Redline_v1.pdf

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Annika Sorensen <annika.sorensen@starlite-health.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <procurement@starlite-health.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy redlines and evidence ask

Annika — thanks for the clear summary and the annotated redline. Looping in Ben (enterprise sales lead), David (product legal liaison) and Laura (solutions/ops) so we can align on evidence path and scope.

Quick responses to the bullets:

- License boundary: we can add a narrow definition limiting "operator runtime activities" and add explicit prohibition on use for derivative model training or distribution. We'll propose exact language by EOD.
- Operator custody: Redwood's default for Private deployments is ephemeral operator keys + HSM-backed signing of snapshots; we can provide HSM attestation records (cert chain + signed nonce) and a hashed manifest for each snapshot.
- Audit window: we can support a 30-day snapshot retention and provide a time-stamped signed manifest that proves snapshot integrity. For live forensic access, we typically request 48-72 hours notice; we could align on 3 business days with limited escalation carveouts.
- Evidence delivery: we'll produce a staged manifest (CSV) mapping artifacts -> checksums -> signing key, plus a short runbook describing retrieval procedures.

Attachment: RI-privdeploy-evidence-checklist.xlsx (internal checklist; will share redacted copy with you after we confirm the exact files).

Next steps proposed:
1) Legal sync (30m): Wednesday 4/3 10am PT — confirm?
2) Redwood to propose draft MSA language for license boundary + operator custody by EOD 4/2.
3) We prepare the evidence manifest template and a sample HSM attestation for your review.

Let me know if the milestone dates work.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Annika Sorensen <annika.sorensen@starlite-health.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy redlines and evidence ask

Aisha — on it. Short note: we can offer a witnessless pathway using HSM-backed ephemeral operator keys + signed snapshot manifests. Operational proposal: 14-day evidence staging period (encrypt-at-rest, checksummed snapshots), HSM attestation (cert + sig), and a 72-hour forensic access SLA with mutual attestation.

Will prepare a 1-pager for the legal call.

-Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Enterprise Sales Operations

From: Annika Sorensen <annika.sorensen@starlite-health.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <procurement@starlite-health.com>, Eric Sun <eric.sun@legalpartners.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy redlines and evidence ask

Aisha / Ben — appreciate the concrete proposals. Two quick points from legal/procurement: 

1) Evidence staging: Starlite prefers that the evidence manifest is certified by a key that is under our control (or a mutually-held HSM) at least for the first handover. We cannot accept unilateral signing without a mutual attestation on chain.

2) Offsite key escrow: procurement will not sign unless there is a clear technical enforcement (e.g., split custody with an auditable recovery procedure). We can accept ephemeral keys if Redwood provides a deterministic attestation pipeline and a demo of the snapshot signing process.

I've uploaded an updated redline (Starlite_Redline_v2.pdf) and shared an updated Order Form via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC-123-Starlite-OrderForm. Please review changes in sections Sched A and Exhibit F.

Quote for context:
> "We need a signed manifest from Redwood accompanied by an HSM cert chain, and the ability to request a limited forensic session within 3 business days."

We can be flexible on the forensic SLA if Redwood provides a mutual attestation and a sample HSM signature proving snapshot provenance. Would you be able to provide a short recording or live demo of the attestation workflow during the legal sync?

Thanks,
Annika

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Annika Sorensen <annika.sorensen@starlite-health.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy redlines and evidence ask

Annika — good to have the updated redline, and appreciate the specificity. Quick confirmation and owners below, plus the evidence manifest we've agreed in principle to produce.

Decisions / owners:
- MSA license boundary language: Redwood legal + David Kim to propose final wording by COB 4/5 (owner: david_kim).
- Operator custody model: offer two tracks — (A) mutual-attestation HSM flow (preferred for Starlite), (B) on-site witnessed handover for the first snapshot. Owner: laura_bennett to run tech demo and produce sample signed manifest by 4/6.
- Evidence manifest: we will provide starlite_required_evidence_manifest.csv mapping artifact -> checksum -> signer, and a short runbook for retrieval. Owner: ben_carter. Delivery: draft 4/6.
- Demo: scheduled legal sync 4/3 10am PT — confirm recording + demo of HSM attestation. If that time doesn't work, alternate: 4/5 11am PT.

Attachments: starlite_required_evidence_manifest.csv (draft), RI-privdeploy-evidence-checklist.xlsx (redacted).

Action items for this thread:
1) David to circulate MSA snippet for license boundary (EOD 4/5).
2) Laura to prepare sample HSM attest and demo plan (draft 4/6).
3) Ben to produce evidence manifest CSV (draft 4/6).
4) Aisha to coordinate DocuSign routing once redlines are agreed.

If everyone is aligned I'll lock the demo slot for 4/3 10am PT and share calendar invites.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
